sections.preparador: Information About the Preparer (if other than you)

i134_confirma_beneficiario_outra_pessoa.label: Will this Form I-134 be completed by you (the sponsor) on behalf of another person (the beneficiary of the financial support)?
i134_confirma_beneficiario_outra_pessoa.hint: Our product only covers sponsoring ANOTHER person (for example, the I-539 applicant). If you are the beneficiary filing on your own behalf, talk to our team -- that specific part of the form (Part 4) is not automated here.

sponsor_outro_nome1_sobrenome.label: Other name used 1 — Family Name
sponsor_outro_nome1_sobrenome.hint: Include aliases, maiden name, or any other name you've ever used.

sponsor_end_correio_cuidado_de.label: Mailing address — In Care Of Name (optional)

sponsor_end_correio_rua.label: Mailing address — Street Number and Name

sponsor_end_correio_provincia.label: Mailing address — Province (if outside the U.S.)

sponsor_end_correio_codigo_postal.label: Mailing address — Postal Code (if outside the U.S.)

sponsor_end_fisico_diferente.label: Is your current physical address different from the mailing address above?
sponsor_end_fisico_diferente.hint: If you live at the same address where you receive mail, choose "No" -- you won't need to repeat the address.

sponsor_end_fisico_cuidado_de.label: Physical address — In Care Of Name (optional)

sponsor_end_fisico_rua.label: Physical address — Street Number and Name

sponsor_end_fisico_provincia.label: Physical address — Province (if outside the U.S.)

sponsor_end_fisico_codigo_postal.label: Physical address — Postal Code (if outside the U.S.)

sponsor_nascimento_provincia.label: Place of birth — State or Province

sponsor_nascimento_cidade.label: Place of birth — City or Town

sponsor_alien_number.label: Alien Registration Number (A-Number), if any
sponsor_alien_number.hint: 9 digits, without the letter "A" (the form already prints "A-" before the field). Leave blank if you've never had an A-Number.

sponsor_uscis_online_account.label: USCIS Online Account Number, if any
sponsor_uscis_online_account.hint: 12 digits. Leave blank if you don't have a USCIS online account.

sponsor_status_imigratorio.label: What is your current immigration status?
sponsor_status_imigratorio.hint: This is the single most important point on this form: only lawful permanent residents (green card holders) or U.S. citizens can serve as a qualifying financial sponsor in this type of case. If your status is something else, talk to our team before continuing.

options.label: Beneficiary of deferred action (including DACA) or Deferred Enforced Departure

sponsor_relacionamento_beneficiario.label: What is your relationship to the beneficiary?

sponsor_situacao_emprego.label: What is your current employment status?

sponsor_quantos_i134_anteriores.label: How many other Form I-134, I-134A, I-864, I-864EZ, or I-864A have you previously submitted (for anyone, including yourself) that your support obligation has not ended?
sponsor_quantos_i134_anteriores.hint: Don't include the beneficiary of this application. If none, enter 0.

sponsor_quantos_outros_dependentes.label: How many other dependents do you support (including yourself)?
sponsor_quantos_outros_dependentes.hint: Don't include the beneficiary of this application.

dependente1_recibo.label: Other dependent 1 — USCIS receipt number (if any)

dependente2_recibo.label: Other dependent 2 — USCIS receipt number (if any)

dependente3_recibo.label: Other dependent 3 — USCIS receipt number (if any)

dependente4_recibo.label: Other dependent 4 — USCIS receipt number (if any)

sponsor_renda_anual.label: What is your current annual income? (in US dollars)

ativo_total.label: Total value of all assets above (in US dollars)

sponsor_intencao_contribuicao_especifica.label: In addition to general financial support, do you intend to make specific contributions to cover the beneficiary's basic living needs (for example, housing, help finding employment, school enrollment)?

sponsor_descricao_contribuicao.label: Describe the specific contributions you will provide
sponsor_descricao_contribuicao.hint: E.g., providing safe and appropriate housing (include the address), helping secure employment once authorized to work, enrolling in school, enrolling in eligible benefits.

benef_outro_nome2_meio.label: Other name used by beneficiary 2 — Middle Name

benef_alien_number.label: Beneficiary's Alien Registration Number (A-Number), if any
benef_alien_number.hint: 9 digits, without the letter "A" (the form already prints "A-" before the field). Leave blank if the person has never had an A-Number.

benef_nascimento_cidade.label: Beneficiary's place of birth — City or Town

benef_estado_civil_outro.label: If "Other": explain the beneficiary's marital status

benef_estadia_data_inicio.label: Start date of the beneficiary's anticipated stay in the U.S.
benef_estadia_data_inicio.hint: Usually matches the start date of the academic program (F-1) or the planned entry date as a tourist (B-2).

benef_estadia_tem_data_fim.label: Is there an anticipated end date for this stay?

options.label: Yes, I have an anticipated date

benef_estadia_data_fim.label: Anticipated end date of the stay

sponsor_certifica_leitura.label: How do you confirm you read and understood this declaration?
sponsor_certifica_leitura.hint: If you need an interpreter, also fill in their information in the next section (Part 6).

options.label: I can read and understand English, and I have read and understood every question and instruction on this form
An interpreter read and translated every question and instruction to me in a language I understand

sponsor_idioma_fluente.label: Which language are you fluent in (the same one used by the interpreter)?

sponsor_telefone_diurno.label: Your daytime telephone number (for contact about this declaration)

sponsor_data_assinatura.label: Date of the sponsor's signature
sponsor_data_assinatura.hint: Usually the date the form will actually be signed by hand before submission.
